title: Summer on the Island Queen and the bridge delay on the Ohio
summary: Desvigne's best trip was a summer on the Island Queen out of Cincinnati, stuck two weeks by high water at a bridge but still paid.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: But the best trips of all, I think it was working on the Steamer Island Queen out of Cincinnati. Yeah, I liked that very much.
Did you stay there the whole summer?

Stayed there the whole summer. We were coming back to New Orleans and that's the time we had the ice all melting and the water all coming into Ohio River and the boat couldn't pass under the bridge. So I remember for two weeks we stayed right at the banks there and the captain said, well, we're going to wait until the water goes down. Which bridge was that?
I mean, is that the Steamer Island? Yeah, around there someplace we couldn't come down the river, you see.
Unless we went down to Cairo, Illinois.
Oh, no, no, no, not that far. And so we waited and we waited and you know what they did? You know the doom up there?

They broke that thing down. Took it off temporarily so the boat could pass underneath the bridge. Took the bridge. I remember that. And we wasn't doing nothing for two weeks but we were drawing our salary right on.
